acceptedAnswer.text: We stand by the quality of our skylight repairs and offer a comprehensive warranty on our workmanship. The specifics of the warranty, including its duration and coverage, will be clearly detailed in your service agreement. This provides peace of mind, knowing that if any issues arise directly from our repair work, we will address them promptly.
